name: Winter ordeal: angles
look: Winter ordeal, the winter shadow of heaven: a xianxia art where a cultivator turns winter into night: the whole night sky above the enemy cracks like a pane of black glass, and its pieces fall as black snow. Every flake is not ice but a small shard of the sky's own shadow, the colour of night, with only a thin cold violet-white edge where starlight catches it; caught in a palm it cuts and hurts. In the cracks of the sky an eye seems about to open. The snow screams as it falls, faster and denser. The mood is silent, cold and final: black on black, a few cold glints, no warm colour and no white snow at all.
subject: black snow

rules: The snow is black, the colour of night, with only a thin cold violet-white edge: never white snow, never a warm colour.
The figure is the enemy: the pane hangs above it, the eye looks down at it and the snow falls on it. Do not draw the figure.
Keep the colours of the second image's palette: no outline in black, no gradients wider than a few pixels.
